## Maintainer ruling recorded — **1A, authorised form**: the dev runs `--update` on the PR branch, the whole baseline diff goes into the PR body, the seat reviews it line by line. `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same stroke.

Director seat, summon 14 (`session_01LsEjuNMPitCHwEfYftZ1um`, GitHub `os-warren`). Provenance: maintainer, live PM chat, 2026-09-04, decision batch #27, verbatim 「同意」 on the presented recommendation for this card (**A**, in the authorised form: dev runs `node scripts/check-role-word.mjs --update` on `claude/issue-15061-catalog-gates-scan-references`, the full `scripts/role-word-baseline.json` diff is pasted into PR #15073's body, the skills seat reviews every line before ready). Premises re-verified on `origin/main` `25a59bd` at 04:41Z: the gate still skips `references` by name (`check-role-word.mjs:57`), the baseline carries no `data-hooks` entry, PR #15073 is draft.

### The ruling

- The twelve `role` occurrences in `skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md` are **quoted history** — the retirement of `session.roles` being documented — which is ADR-0090 D3's own named legitimate kind. They enter the shrink-only baseline; this comment is the maintainer's agreement the gate's MAINTAINER-ONLY text asks for.
- ⛔ Not B (rewording falsifies the page), ⛔ not C (prose is not a vendor wire payload), ⛔ not D (no half landing).
- The `:733` example query `where: { role: 'admin' }` stays as written — it is the better-auth `sys_member.role` field D3 already carves out, not a role-word use to rename.

### Execution constraints, for the skills seat

- Same branch, same PR (#15073, `Fixes #15061`); the `--update` run rewrites the whole file — the PR body carries the full diff and the review confirms **only** the `data-hooks.md` entry is added (any other file moving in the rewrite is a stop-and-report, not a rider).
- `check:corpus-claim-drift` stays green with its ledger unchanged (the PR already measured this); both self-tests keep their new population pins.
- Not a governed surface (two `scripts/` gates + one JSON baseline): ordinary queue landing after the seat's review. Clause-②: no.
- This card closes with PR #15073 (`Part of` here is enough; #15061 is the `Fixes`).

Ruling authority: maintainer 2026-09-04 (batch #27). Related: #15061 · PR #15073 · ADR-0090 D3 · #8435.

## Maintainer ruling recorded — B: rewrite the page to ADR-0090 D3 vocabulary first; the baseline admits only the residue

Director seat, summon 13, session_01WXyGTWPbbreqXow7Z2pZCk, 2026-09-04.

Provenance (who / verbatim / where): maintainer, live chat with the director seat, 2026-09-04 ~04:5xZ. The maintainer stated that this card's recommendation (admit all twelve to the baseline) was a seat's text, not the maintainer's view, and asked for a re-evaluation; after it, verbatim: 「按照你的建议，跟进并处理完这两个pr。」 — adopts the director's option B.

**Why not A (all twelve).** Read on `origin/main`, only five of the twelve occurrences are the quoted retirement note (and it is stated three times on one page); six use the reserved word as live vocabulary ("for a role", "per-role exemption", "role-aware", "role name"), which is exactly what D3 reserves against and can be rewritten without falsifying anything; one is an example query on a `role` field no `sys_user` carries. This page ships to third parties via `npx skills add`, so admitting twelve teaches AI readers the reserved word and weakens the ratchet by twelve at first sight.

**Ruled: B.**
1. Card #15151 (skills lane, `pm:queue`, p2): rewrite the page — one retirement note kept, one warning against `ctx.session?.roles` kept, the rest in D3 vocabulary, the example fixed. Governed surface: draft PR, both approver accounts, human merge.
2. PR #15073 waits on that page (card #15061 → `pm:blocked`, `Blocked-by: #15151`), then adds the baseline entry for the residue (expected 3 to 4, all quoted history) via `node scripts/check-role-word.mjs --update` — the ⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY act, authorized by the maintainer for the residue only — and lands.

This decision card is closed as ruled; the work lives on #15151 and #15061.
